run_single_problem: run the agent on a single leaderboard problem instance and return the problem id
run_experiment_sweep: run a sweep over all classification_2d problem ids using the specified agent name
load_paper_agent: load a benchmark agent from the testbed factories by agent name and sweep id
evaluate_agent_kl: evaluate an agent on a problem and return the KL quality score
run_single_problem_cli: run the experiment via CLI with --agent_name mlp --problem_id classification_2d/0
